title: The Pond Concert and the Neighbor with the Quietest Ears

issues.evidence: After the ending action is already narrated—“Nora answered with one round silver bubble”—the final paragraph repeats it: “A single silver bubble rose beside the lily.”
issues.fix: Replace the repeated bubble sentence with a new closing image or consequence of Nora’s response.

issues.evidence: The final two paragraphs nearly duplicate the trace’s closing image: “Nora glided past on the lily while Frog sang from its middle” and “The leaf boat bumped along behind like a very small royal carriage.”
issues.fix: Keep the traced parade/bow once, then end with a distinct consequential closing beat rather than restating the same action twice.

critic_before_revision.strengths: All three stories accurately realize the ordered knowledge, invitation, ownership, concert-choice, performance, and response changes; seed 124 in particular cleanly grounds the bell transfer and duet.
